description:
Goal
Express the boundary-publication closure as monotone propagation along the explicit Merged/return binding edges, making the root fan-in pure concatenation. Re-point the real consumers off the whole-root TransportPlan object.

What
- Replace expand_boundary_publications (jobs/transport.rs:390) and resolve_publication_source_boundaries (421) with propagation facts: a publication at position P flows to P iff a Merged (Stage 2) or callsite_callee_return_position binding edge links them; close to quiescence. Transitive classes may chain >=3 executables (f->g->h) so propagation must be edge-following, not pairwise. HIGHEST-RISK ticket.
- Boundary resolutions become a derived per-boundary fact accumulating publications from its class (additive, extend_unique semantics preserved).
- Re-point consumers: materialize_root (jobs/artifact.rs) and native.rs read per-executable facts; the two whole-root iterations (materialized_executable_transport, materialized_transport_plan) get a per-executable position enumeration instead of iterating plan.positions.keys() globally.
- Delete the assembly-side closure from the fan-in.

Verify
shadow==monolith green; full transport_contract_test.rs green (boundary inventory/per-surface tests are the guard); transport_validation.rs green; native + interp + build parity; zero warnings.
title: Stage 3: boundary closure as propagation facts; re-point consumers; delete fan-in closure
